children: Mistras Group entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Athena Purchaser, an affiliate of H.I.G. Capital, to be acquired for $20.35 per share in cash. The deal is subject to a majority stockholder vote, regulatory approvals and other customary conditions, and includes a 40-day go-shop period. Termination fees are approximately $27.5 million for the company (reduced by half for a go-shop superior proposal) and $49.9 million for the buyer in certain circumstances. The transaction is not subject to a financing condition, with equity and debt commitments in place.
: Go-private transaction to maximize stockholder value
